words.cell: Energy cell: one share of today's solar power.
words.msv: Millisievert (mSv): a unit for radiation dose.
words.flare: Solar flare: a sudden bright burst on the Sun.
words.sep: Solar particle storm: fast particles from the Sun. They add dose.
words.conj: Solar conjunction: the Sun sits between Mars and Earth.

text.helper.aChanceGoingOutsideAdds: A chance! Going outside adds dose. You can let it go.
text.helper.aChanceIsTemptingGo: A chance is tempting: go outside (card + sample, but dose and a lost job), scan from the lab (needs lab power and the scientist), or let it go.
text.helper.aSolarParticleStormRaises: A solar particle storm raises everyone's dose unless the shield has full power.
text.helper.aSolarStormHitsToday: A solar storm hits today. Power the shield to keep dose low.
text.helper.aTankIsEmptyOne: A tank is empty! One more empty sol ends the mission.
text.helper.atTheseLevelsNobodyFeels: At these levels nobody feels ill. Astronauts still keep dose as low as they can, because it adds up over a whole career.
text.helper.eachLineShowsWhatChanged: Each line shows what changed and why.
text.helper.eachMorningYouLearnWhat: Each morning you learn what changed overnight, and Earth answers last night's message.
text.helper.eachPersonDoesOneJob: Each person does one job per sol. Specialists do their own job twice as well: engineer fix, medic care, botanist grow, scientist lab, pilot outside.
text.helper.everyChoiceCostsSomethingCheck: Every choice costs something. Check the plan, then go.
text.helper.everyLineNamesAChange: Every line names a change and its cause. Nothing here is a hidden dice roll: the same plan on the same Mars gives the same result.
text.helper.everyoneIsRestingGiveThe: Everyone is resting. Give the crew jobs with the buttons.
text.helper.everyTripOutsideAddsMsv: Every trip outside adds {doseOutsideTrip} mSv to the dose badge. The badge only fills.
text.helper.extraCellsGoBackTo: Extra cells! Go back to the plan to share them.
text.helper.heavySolsInARow: {heavySolsToTired} heavy sols in a row (fix, outside) make a person tired: half effect until they rest. Heavy work while tired means the medbay.
text.helper.ifAirWaterOrFood: If air & water or food stays at 0 for {zeroSols}, Mission Control calls the crew home early. Nobody dies.
text.helper.isIllAndMustRest: {name} is ill and must rest, or it gets worse.
text.helper.isTiredHeavyWorkWill: {name} is tired. Heavy work will hurt. Give them a rest.
text.helper.lifeSupportIsShortAir: Life support is short. Air and water will drop tonight.
text.helper.lifeSupportWantsEachMissing: Life support wants {want}: each missing cell costs 1 air & water tonight. A 4th cell gives 1 back.
text.helper.noChoiceIsFreeRead: No choice is free. Read the prices, then pick one.
text.helper.noSamplesYetHasNothing: No samples yet. {name} has nothing to study in the lab.
text.helper.nothingIsBrokenInsideHas: Nothing is broken inside. {name} has nothing to fix.
text.helper.oneMessagePerSolAnd: One message per sol, and only if the radio had a cell. Earth answers at breakfast.
text.helper.oneMessageTonightEarthAnswers: One message tonight. Earth answers at breakfast.
text.helper.onSolsTheSunSits: On sols {names} the Sun sits between Mars and Earth (solar conjunction), so the radio cannot reach Earth.
text.helper.pickWhoGoesCheckTheir: Pick who goes. Check their dose badge first.
text.helper.radioSignalsNeed3To: Radio signals need 3 to 22 minutes one way, so nobody steers a Mars mission live. (Source: NASA/JPL)
text.helper.readTheMorningNewsThen: Read the morning news, then plan the sol.
text.helper.readyPressPlayToRun: Ready? Press Play to run the sol.
text.helper.scienceOnlyCountsForCards: Science only counts for cards that were sent home with the science report.
text.helper.stormTodayAndTheShield: Storm today and the shield is weak. Everyone gets extra dose.
text.helper.theLabIsDarkCan: The lab is dark. {name} can't work there without power.
text.helper.theRadioNeedsCellTo: The radio needs {want} cell to send tonight's message. The lab needs {want2} cells or no science happens.
text.helper.theShieldOnlyMattersWhen: The shield ({want}) matters most when a solar storm hits; at full power it also trims the everyday dose a little. The greenhouse grows 1 crop step per cell; {cropStepsToHarvest} steps = harvest, Food +{harvestFood}.
text.helper.theSkySetsTodayS: The sky sets today's energy: clear {clear} cells, hazy {hazy}, dust storm {dust}.
text.helper.theSunBlocksTheRadio: The Sun blocks the radio today. Earth cannot hear us.
text.helper.theSystemsWantMoreCells: The systems want more cells than the Sun gives, so something always goes short.
text.helper.troubleHas2Or3: Trouble has 2 or 3 choices and none is free. Trouble left alone grows where you can see it.
text.helper.welcomeCaptainReadTheMorning: Welcome, Captain! Read the morning news, then plan the sol.
text.helper.youCanGoBackTo: You can go back to the plan and change cells or jobs before you play the sol.
text.helper.youHaveUnusedCellsAre: You have {free}. Unused cells are lost at sunset.
text.report.greenhouseLowPowerOneSol: The greenhouse had too little power on sol {from}.
text.report.greenhouseLowPowerSols: The greenhouse had too little power on sols {from}–{to}.
text.report.greenhouseNoPowerOneSol: The greenhouse had no power on sol {from}.
text.report.greenhouseNoPowerSols: The greenhouse had no power on sols {from}–{to}.
text.report.lifeSupportWasShortOf: Life support was short of power on {sols}{tail}
text.report.neverWentHomeSendThe: {cards} never went home. Send the science report.
text.report.onlyCameInMoreHands: Only {harvests} came in. More hands in the greenhouse would help.
text.report.onlyFoundTakeChancesAnd: Only {cards} found. Take chances and power the lab.
text.report.theLeakedForFixIt: The {problem} leaked for {sols}{tail} Fix it early.
text.rules.healedInSolsSoonerWith: Healed in {illnessMedbaySteps} sols, sooner with care
text.rules.labAndRadioGoDark: Lab and radio go dark today
text.rules.lessDoseIfTheShield: Less dose if the shield is weak
text.rules.needsRestSolsInA: Needs {sickRestSolsToCure} rest sols in a row
text.rules.noMedbayIfTheRest: No medbay if the rest goes on
text.rules.oneCrewMemberDropsTheir: One crew member drops their job
text.rules.outOfWorkNoThird: Out of work. No third star
text.rules.panelsStayCleanAfterThe: Panels stay clean after the storm
text.rules.sendSomeoneToPolishThe: Send someone to polish the panels
text.rules.sendSomeoneToTiltThe: Send someone to tilt the panels
text.rules.theChanceIsGoneBy: The chance is gone by morning
text.rules.theLabHasNoPower: The lab has no power. Go back to the plan.
text.rules.theScientistIsInThe: The scientist is in the medbay
text.rules.theyGetExtraDoseAnd: They get extra dose and drop their jobs
text.rules.todaySJobGetsDone: Today's job gets done at half power
text.rules.todaySPlanStaysA: Today's plan stays. A fixer is set for tomorrow
text.sol.aPatientHealsOneSol: A patient heals one sol sooner
text.sol.dustStormIsOverPanels: Dust storm is over. Panels are dusty: fewer cells.
text.sol.dustStormIsOverThe: Dust storm is over. The panels stayed clean.
text.sol.earthGotYourScienceReport: Earth got your science report. Thank you!
text.sol.earthSentARepairTrick: Earth sent a repair trick. {name} needs less work.
text.sol.earthSentTheSpaceWeather: Earth sent the space weather forecast. See it below.
text.sol.harvestCameInNewCrop: Harvest came in. New crop is at {steps}
text.sol.howCanWeFixIt: How can we fix it faster?
text.sol.hullIsHoldingNothingIs: Hull is holding. Nothing is broken.
text.sol.isSetToFixThe: {name} is set to fix the {problem} today.
text.sol.landingDoneTheStationIs: Landing done. The station is running.
text.sol.noMessageTonightTheRadio: No message tonight: the radio had no cell.
text.sol.noRadioTheAntennaIs: No radio: the antenna is off.
text.sol.noWordFromEarthThe: No word from Earth. The Sun is in the way.
text.sol.noWordFromEarthThe2: No word from Earth. The antenna is off.
text.sol.oneMoreEmptySolEnds: one more empty sol ends the mission
text.sol.radioBlackoutTheSunIs: Radio blackout: the Sun is between Mars and Earth.
text.sol.shieldAtFullPowerMinimum: shield at full power: minimum dose inside
text.sol.solarStormDoseXWithout: Solar storm: dose x{mult} without shield
text.sol.theDoctorsHelpedHealsOne: The doctors helped. {name} heals one sol sooner.
text.sol.theDoctorsHelpedLeavesThe: The doctors helped. {name} leaves the medbay today.
text.sol.theDoctorsHelpedNeedsLess: The doctors helped. {name} needs less bed rest.
text.sol.theOpenRepairNeedsLess: The open repair needs less work
text.sol.theShipHomeLandsOn: The ship home lands on sol {missionSols}.
text.sol.whatWillSpaceWeatherBe: What will space weather be like?
text.sol.missionControlSentTasks: Mission Control sent {count} tasks. They are on the board.
